mentions.claim_text: A million person prayer warrior army coming on the channel daily, with great favour and anointing on it to build a prayer network that changes governments.
mentions.quote: you will have a million uh prayer Warrior Army
mentions.falsify_match: a million daily participants on the channel

mentions.claim_text: An instruction to pray against an attempt on Trump from the air while he is playing golf, alongside a harvest in Canada from shore to shore.
mentions.quote: him playing golf and trying to get him from the air
mentions.falsify_match: an aerial attempt on the president at a golf course

mentions.claim_text: People drawn like bugs to a light as the body of Christ shines, asking how it is light in Goshen while it is so dark elsewhere.
mentions.quote: how is it light in Canaan how is it dark
mentions.falsify_match: a visible separation between believers and the wider society

mentions.claim_text: An angelic host warring on behalf of the president, with one last revival and harvest across Canada, Mexico, Europe and Asia.
mentions.quote: a mighty Angelic host of army coming and Waring in behalf of President Trump
mentions.falsify_match: the president coming through the term unharmed with a global revival

mentions.claim_text: The greatest outpouring in this window declared, and a spirit bound in a judge up north in New York said to be causing havoc and torment.
mentions.quote: this judge that is North up north in in New York we bind that spirit
mentions.falsify_match: a named New York judge being removed or reversed
mentions.falsify_miss: no such outcome; the judge is not named

mentions.claim_text: More to uncover about France and Europe with the Eiffel Tower shown again, and the words London Bridge is falling down sung over England with a call for hidden things in London to be revealed.
mentions.quote: London Bridge is falling down falling down
mentions.falsify_match: a structural failure or attack at a London bridge
mentions.falsify_miss: no such event; the words are a nursery rhyme, which makes the reading loose

mentions.claim_text: Buildings completely wiped out with attackers getting as close as they could to the Capitol and to major Washington landmarks, and lone wolves in America who are sympathetic but act alone.
mentions.quote: they tried to get as close as they could to the capital

mentions.claim_text: Vans carrying barrels of fertiliser parked in New York garages and beside buildings so as not to look suspicious, positioned close to Trump towers with a plan to take them out.
mentions.quote: I saw Vans with the barrels full of fertilizer inside of there
mentions.falsify_match: a fertiliser vehicle bomb found or used in New York

mentions.claim_text: The plan given as retaliation for the killing of Soleimani, which they say they have not forgotten, carried out by a thousand men who came through dark underground tunnels.
mentions.quote: it was in retaliation for Assam sulamani
mentions.falsify_match: an Iranian directed attack inside America framed as revenge for Soleimani

mentions.claim_text: Darkness in ten major cities, the thousand men divided into ten groups of a hundred coming up out of the ground like ants, which he says is an act of war by a government rather than terrorism.
mentions.quote: this is not terrorist per se this is an act of War
mentions.falsify_match: coordinated attacks across ten American cities

mentions.claim_text: The chatter concerns Trump hotels and Trump locations, and Europe as well, which he connects to what happened the day before.
mentions.quote: it was about Trump hotels Trump locations
mentions.falsify_match: an attack on a Trump property

mentions.claim_text: New Orleans described as the darkest of the three but with only one man, while Nashville and Las Vegas carry mass plans with many people, and he says there are more than these two.
mentions.quote: New Orleans is darkest but but there's just one man
mentions.falsify_match: attacks in those cities matching the ranking he gives
mentions.falsify_miss: no attacks; New Orleans was hit by a single attacker on 1 January 2025, which matches the one man detail

mentions.claim_text: He states the New Orleans impression was not as intense as Nashville, and that only one individual was seen there while Nashville was hotter.
mentions.quote: it was not as intense to um be concerned about
mentions.falsify_match: a larger attack at Nashville than at New Orleans
mentions.falsify_miss: the opposite, which is what happened

mentions.claim_text: Three men who came across the southern border, major cells throughout America with plans, the name Islamic State given, and Bourbon Street shown, with an instruction to pray for Nashville.
mentions.falsify_match: an Islamic State linked attack on Bourbon Street, which occurred on 1 January 2025

mentions.claim_text: Terrorist attacks starting to be attempted in Europe, coming out of Toronto, and into Pennsylvania and New York, strong enough to shake the world.
mentions.quote: I saw terrorist attacks coming out of Toronto
mentions.falsify_match: an attack traced to Toronto reaching Pennsylvania or New York

mentions.claim_text: A prayer that the darkness be exposed like turning the light on in a kitchen so the roaches flee, and that the plots be uncovered.
mentions.quote: you turn the lights on in a kitchen and the roaches flee

mentions.claim_text: Revival called over Germany, where he says Berlin is and where he saw the Antichrist go one day, and over Brazil, Nigeria, New Zealand and Puerto Rico.
mentions.quote: that's where I saw the Antichrist going in in in Germany
mentions.falsify_match: a figure identified as the Antichrist operating from Berlin

mentions.claim_text: A rapid list of countries called out for a supernatural harvest as viewers name their locations, which he ends by praying for the whole world at once.
mentions.quote: just say for all world that thing is going like this
mentions.falsify_miss: no measurable movement; the list is read from viewer comments rather than seen
